defensives.name: Divine Protection
defensives.usage_rule: Press it ahead of damage you know is coming to you, and remember it cannot reduce what Blessing of Sacrifice transfers to you.

defensives.name: Blessing of Sacrifice
defensives.usage_rule: Throw it on whoever is about to eat a big hit and watch your own health, because you take the damage it prevents.

defensives.name: Blessing of Protection
defensives.usage_rule: Use it to immune physical damage or strip a physical debuff, and keep it off the tank because the target loses all threat.

defensives.name: Divine Shield
defensives.usage_rule: Drop it to survive a mistake, to immune the damage your Blessing of Sacrifice transfers, or to take yourself out of the healing pool during heavy group damage.

defensives.name: Lay on Hands
defensives.usage_rule: Save it for a player who dies before your next heal lands, or for yourself when everything else is down.
